comparison.objective: Withdraw an uphill sample rod hand over hand through shrouds without letting it roll back; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Alternating bimanual regrasping, continuous support, and constrained linear extraction versus hex-key seating, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Achieve 17.2 cm rod travel to the target band with guide-disturbance gating; candidate requires two repeatable safe impacts and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Both demand bimanual coordination, but hand-over-hand extraction under gravity is a different core ability from precision adjustment, fastening, and dynamic commissioning.
